title: Courtesy Late-Fee Waivers on Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreements: Care Center Desk Guidance
content:
**Rule.** At the tenant's request the care center may waive one posted late fee or second late fee on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement as a courtesy, crediting its full amount. A courtesy waiver never covers part of a fee and never covers rent, lien-process fees, returned-payment fees, transfer fees or move-out fees. A late fee that was posted in error is reversed under the billing-correction rule instead and does not use the courtesy allowance.

## Conditions the desk applies

1. **The fee.** The waived fee is a late fee or a second late fee entry on the same rental agreement.
2. **Tenure.** A courtesy waiver may be granted only when the handling date is not earlier than the move-in date plus the class's courtesy-waiver tenure in months. Months are calendar months counted from the move-in date to the same day of the later month, falling back to that month's last day when the day does not exist.
3. **Status.** The rental is in active, delinquent or moving out status; once a lien notice has been sent no courtesy waiver is given.
4. **Allowance.** The courtesy waivers already granted on the agreement — the courtesy late-fee waiver credits whose posting date falls in the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the handling date, inclusive — number fewer than the class's courtesy waivers per rolling 12 months.
5. **Not already credited.** A fee that has already been waived or corrected is not waived again.

Each condition is read from the company's records for that agreement: the move-in date, the status, the ledger entry of the fee and the credits already posted against it.

## Tenure boundary (hypothetical, 6-month class tenure)

| Move-in date | Six calendar months later | Handling date | Tenure met |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 15 September | 15 September | yes, equality satisfies |
| 15 March | 15 September | 14 September | no |
| 31 August 2026 | 28 February 2027 (February has no 31st) | 28 February 2027 | yes |

## Allowance (hypothetical class allowing 1 per rolling 12 months)

An agreement with one courtesy waiver posted 200 days before the handling date has used its allowance; one whose only earlier courtesy waiver was posted 400 days before the handling date has not.

## Basis questions

- *Can half of a $45.00 late fee be waived?* No; a courtesy waiver credits the full amount of the fee or nothing.
- *Can a lien notice fee be waived as a courtesy?* No; only a late fee or a second late fee is eligible.
